text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying she will only cause more trouble, 
Rice Shower announces she is quitting the 
team. Ever since, she stopped coming to 
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This made the other members realize they 
had been wrong to hold themselves back 
just to avoid disrupting the team's 
harmony.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While trying to persuade Rice Shower, 
Matikanefukukitaru chimes in, saying her 
fortune says going to the beach right now 
will bring good luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Rice Shower stopped them with sound 
logic, she was praised as an essential 
voice of reason. Having regained her 
confidence, she was back on her feet.
